structural_audit.scope: Structural lifecycle, DMA and physical resources only; numerical acceptance failed separately

dma_timing.contract: first layer X input DMA send to final layer Y final DMA ACK
dma_timing.note: Stage spans overlap; cannot be summed. Includes handoff/reset between layers; excludes host preload/startup and final exit.

final_norm_dataflow.contract: first layer X input DMA send to final RMSNorm output DMA ACK

add_norm_fusion.payload: one residual GM read, complete packed Norm writes, bounded Add/Norm SFU pairs

actual_projection_payload.scope: actual GM read ACKs in each full-row Norm1 batch; zero activation HBM reads

input_residency.scope: projection retains the already-read input; Add uses a timed local GM read

actual_payload.scope: timed complete payload reads; no cross-stage overwrite; per-chunk read ACK before in-place write

output_residency.scope: Timed GM Y write ACK coverage precedes ownership publication and job completion; final layer retains HBM output.

block_pipeline.note: Both engines may prepare concurrently; all 64 arrays have one exclusive C owner. Overlap counters are not additive critical-path time.

resources.scope: all decoder DMA bytes agree with job counters; no outstanding GM interval crosses job completion
resources.note: DMA transport duration is RTT; GM local duration is a logical request service span (banked spans can overlap); physical beats require bank stats. They overlap and must not be summed.

gm_banks.scope: Counter conservation and drained bounded queues; cycle arbitration and data semantics are tested by production probe and RTL differential.
